Should a follow-up round spend its one live stock start explicitly navigating into "Language Selection" and selecting German (a deliberate, not-undone persisted change to the shared installs save data, on the reasoning that German is the documented correct default and resetting to it is a restoration rather than a new deviation) before capturing the real B1 reference image, or should English be accepted as this installs now-real persisted state and the German-menus quirk note be narrowed to "the retail games own default," with B1s reference image captured in whatever language the install actually produces?
